images.title: Know your true profit on every Etsy sale.
images.sub: Every fee, every listing, every payout, explained to the cent.

images.title: Want $8 profit a candle? List at $22.01.
images.sub: Or $27.48 if the sale comes through Offsite Ads. The price is solved backwards from every fee.

images.title: Three steps to your real numbers.

steps.head: Set your fees once
steps.text: Etsy's US fees are filled in. Pick your Offsite Ads tier.

steps.head: Enter your listings
steps.text: Price and costs. Each one gets OK, WATCH or REPRICE.

steps.head: Check every payout
steps.text: Log orders and deposits. The balance must read $0.00.

images.title: Net profit, margin and a flag on every listing.
images.sub: Revenue, every Etsy fee, net profit, margin and the flag, one row per listing. Red means reprice.

images.title: See what one ad sale does to your margin.
images.sub: At a 15% ad fee, four of five sample listings should be repriced for ad sales.

images.title: Explain every deposit to the cent.
images.sub: Enter the deposit and its dates. The sheet pulls every fee and shows the variance.

images.title: Your true profit, on one screen.
images.sub: Plus profit by month, where the fees went, best and worst listings and your tax reserve.
